$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026 via pdftotext -layout, paginated, from 'KICHECHE/2027 Kicheche Camps STO Rates.pdf' (10pp, issued 27 April 2026). 4 properties, each clearly labeled: Kicheche Mara North, Kicheche Bush Olare, Kicheche Valley Naboisho (all Maasai Mara conservancies), Kicheche Laikipia (Ol Pejeta Conservancy).

changesFrom2026.kichecheValleyNaboisho: Now open year-round from June 2026 (previously seasonal)
changesFrom2026.juneSeasonShift: June moves from Regular to Mid season effective 2027
changesFrom2026.childAgeLimit: 7+ years at Kicheche Bush Olare and Kicheche Valley Naboisho (reminder of existing policy)

regular.dates: 01 Mar - 31 Mar 27, 23 May - 31 May 27, 01 Nov - 19 Dec 27

Kicheche Bush Olare.childAgeBracket: 7-11 years (Young Adult 12-17); children under 7 not permitted

Kicheche Valley Naboisho.childAgeBracket: 7-11 years (Young Adult 12-17); children under 7 not permitted
Kicheche Valley Naboisho.honeymoonOffer: 25% off accommodation for the bride Jul-Sep, 50% off rest of year, plus free half-hour massage (travel within 12 months of wedding)

conservancyFees.note: Includes Ol Pejeta Conservancy entrance AND Wilderness zone bednight fees

Kicheche Laikipia.nonPackageRates: Available subject to conditions - contact Kicheche directly

commonPolicy.familySuite: Max 5 pax, 2 ensuite bedrooms (double + twin/triple), guaranteed exclusive vehicle use
commonPolicy.singleSupplementRule: Valid for 2 singles per booking; double supplement charged from 3rd single onward
commonPolicy.youngAdultChildRateException: Young Adults (12-17) qualify for child rates only if sharing a Triple or Quad room

lateDeparture.unit: per person, if departing after midday

specialOffers.longStayDiscount: 10% off for 6+ nights (also applies to exclusive vehicle charges)
specialOffers.conservancySafari: Combine Kicheche Laikipia with any Mara camp: 6 nights for the price of 5 (free night at Laikipia); conservancy fees still payable on free night

walkingWildernessPackage.description: 5-night exclusive package: 2 nights Kicheche Valley Naboisho + 1 night mobile Wild Camping (walk across Naboisho Conservancy) + 2 nights Kicheche Bush Olare (via morning walk through Olare Motorogi Conservancy). Min 2 pax, 16+ only on walks.
walkingWildernessPackage.unit: per person sharing, inclusive of conservancy fees

exclusiveVehicle.note: 4-6 guest bookings automatically get exclusive vehicle at no extra cost. Families with children under 7 MUST book exclusive vehicle.

tourLeaderRate.unit: per night accommodation, plus conservancy fees (Mara non-resident $150/night, Laikipia non-resident $187/night)

wildCamping.unit: per person per night supplement, min 2 max 6 pax
wildCamping.note: children under 16 not allowed on walks

maraNationalReserveVisit.note: Kicheche camps don't require Reserve visits for game viewing (low-density conservancy model) - this is an optional extra

cancellationPolicy: 45+ days before arrival: loss of deposit only; 45-31 days: 50%; 30 days or less: 100%. Groups (3+ tents): 90+ days loss of deposit, 90-31 days 50%, 30 or less 100%.
paymentTerms: 20% non-refundable deposit; full payment 45 days before arrival
transfersNote: Detailed inter-camp and Mara-wide vehicle transfer rate chart captured in source (pages 8-9) - not transcribed in full here given volume; refer to source PDF directly for a specific route if needed.
